direct_growth_rationale: The 15-Oct-2026 Q2 disclosure reports double-digit volume growth and sales growth20.5%, with advertising up46% and EBITDA margin23.8%. Forecasts incorporate stronger volume than a FY26-only extrapolation, fade to mature growth and stress cocoa, milk and edible-oil costs. Exact volume/price split is analyst judgment, not disclosed guidance.

research_notes.finding: 15-Oct-2026 official company filing establishes Q2 sales growth20.5%, double-digit volume growth, advertising/marketing spending up46% and EBITDA margin23.8%. These management-release figures are standalone. The consolidated statement is separately included in the same filing. Forecasts use this direction without treating the unspecified volume/price split as fact.

research_notes.finding: Shares doubled on11-Aug-2025. FY26 current denominator is1928314320 shares. FY25 closing shares are unadjusted history; published comparative EPS is bonus-adjusted. The fifteen-month FY2023-24 transition is not treated as a twelve-month comparable.

DCF deducts INR2089.83cr pension/gratuity carrying liabilities (noncurrent18326.4m + current2571.9m) as an explicit debt-like proxy. The model does not pretend these are bank borrowings. Funding timetable, taxes and other contingencies require further work.
Secondary DDM uses lower forecast payout than historical cash dividends/earnings to allow reinvestment and retirement funding. It is a policy scenario, not declared future dividends.

market_notes: 31-Mar-2026 balance and share basis rolled forward with estimated uniform interim FCFE, not a reported October balance.
Assume INR5 per share distribution after balance date. Payment timing is an explicit analyst case assumption, not independently confirmed bank settlement.
16-Oct close is the last dated reference used here. Latest intraday prices and later dilution are not asserted.
Other debt-like claims and nonoperating assets are carrying-value proxies. Minority buyout, pension and lease policies are described in Research.
